name: Lanternreach
objective: Fell five Gaunts at the wall, then defeat the Bellringer
lore: When the World Heart broke, the plateau of Lanternreach fell into a long dusk, and the Gaunts walked out of the marsh mist: hollow giants with nothing inside them but a single coal of stolen light, the nape-knot, burning at the back of the neck. The lantern-city behind its great wall has held ever since. It is the one place in the sundered worlds where a tether and a quick blade matter more than a strong arm.
mechanics: Gaunts and the Bellringer take almost nothing from blows to the body (6% for a Gaunt, 12% for a Runt, 5% for the Bellringer) and a body hit can never kill.

Each giant carries a nape-knot, a separate hittable target at the back of the neck. Hits to it deal 3.0 to 3.5 times damage (1.25 times more from a hooked flurry or a plunge, 1.2 times only for bolts and daggers).
Moonhook on any part of a giant carries the hero up behind the neck for the three-slash flurry; the last slash topples it.
Rooftops, the watchtowers and the wall top are real heights the hero can jump onto; shed 2.4 m, house 4.4 m, balcony 6.2 m, tower 8.5 m, wall 9.5 m.
solids: a 9.5 m wall with a Great Gate and two posterns, 18 house blocks with sheds, balconies and watchtowers, ruined walls and dead trees in the fields
unlockedBy: open from the start through any World Gate (a side world, not one of the four shards)
